_comment_eventbus_tick_interval: Bench-only override. The Tiger Motors deployment uses 0.01s (100 Hz) for fine-grained Andon utilization counters. At N=1000 that fanout (100,000 queue.put() calls/sec on the tick thread) saturates the GIL and starves paho's receive thread, so the engine never dispatches any MQTT message. The benchmark measures dispatch latency, not utilization-counter accuracy, so we run the tick at 1 Hz instead.
